WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
filtered_ws AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
filtered_ca AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
),
date_range AS (
  SELECT d1.d_date_sk AS d1_date_sk, d1.d_date AS d1_date, d2.d_date_sk AS d2_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d1
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
  WHERE d1.d_year = 2001
),
warehouse_store AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state
  FROM warehouse w
  INNER JOIN store s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filtered_item fi
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d1_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_ws ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d2_date_sk
INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_ca ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse_store ws_st ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = ws_st.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ss_item_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk,
            ss_customer_sk,
            ss_quantity
        FROM
            store_sales
    ) ss
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            d_date_sk,
            d_date
        FROM
            date_dim
        WHERE
            d_year = 2001
    ) d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk
        FROM
            item
        WHERE
            i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
            AND i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
    ) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            inv_item_sk,
            inv_date_sk,
            inv_warehouse_sk,
            inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM
            inventory
    ) inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            ws_item_sk,
            ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws_bill_customer_sk,
            ws_warehouse_sk,
            ws_wholesale_cost
        FROM
            web_sales
        WHERE
            ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
    ) ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            d_date_sk,
            d_date
        FROM
            date_dim
        WHERE
            d_year = 2001
    ) d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            w_warehouse_sk,
            w_state
        FROM
            warehouse
    ) w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            s_store_sk,
            s_state
        FROM
            store
    ) s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            c_customer_sk,
            c_current_cdemo_sk,
            c_current_hdemo_sk,
            c_current_addr_sk
        FROM
            customer
    ) c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            ca_address_sk
        FROM
            customer_address
        WHERE
            ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
    ) ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            cd_demo_sk,
            cd_gender,
            cd_marital_status,
            cd_education_status
        FROM
            customer_demographics
    ) cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            hd_demo_sk,
            hd_vehicle_count
        FROM
            household_demographics
    ) hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
    cnt;

WITH filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_sk
  FROM (
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'store' AS source
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  ) all_sources
  INNER JOIN filtered_items fi ON fi.i_brand_id = all_sources.i_brand_id
    AND fi.i_class_id = all_sources.i_class_id
    AND fi.i_category_id = all_sources.i_category_id
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_sk, all_sources.i_brand_id, all_sources.i_class_id, all_sources.i_category_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT all_sources.source) = 3
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT (SUM(sum_sales) / SUM(count_rows)) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x
),
target_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1999 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_1999,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1998 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_1998
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE (d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5)
     OR (d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5)
),
yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN dd.d_week_seq = tw.week_1999 THEN 'this_year'
      WHEN dd.d_week_seq = tw.week_1998 THEN 'last_year'
    END AS year_flag,
    SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  INNER JOIN filtered_items i ON ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN cross_items ci ON ss_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim dd ON ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN target_weeks tw
  WHERE (dd.d_week_seq = tw.week_1999 OR dd.d_week_seq = tw.week_1998)
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, year_flag
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT
  'store' AS ty_channel,
  this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
  this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
  'store' AS ly_channel,
  last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
  last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM yearly_sales this_year
INNER JOIN yearly_sales last_year
  ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
  AND this_year.year_flag = 'this_year'
  AND last_year.year_flag = 'last_year'
ORDER BY ty_channel, ty_brand, ty_class, ty_category
LIMIT 100;

  FROM item i
  WHERE i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM store_sales ss
      INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
      WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM catalog_sales cs
      INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
      WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM web_sales ws
      INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
      WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )

avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales

SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year,
       curr_yr.d_year AS year,
       curr_yr.i_brand_id,
       curr_yr.i_class_id,
       curr_yr.i_category_id,
       curr_yr.i_manufact_id,
       prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
       curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM sales_2002 curr_yr
JOIN sales_2001 prev_yr
  ON curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id
  AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id
  AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id

  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) / CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100

with base_date as (
  select d_date_sk
  from date_dim
  where d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date)
                   and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day
),
base_item as (
  select i_item_sk
  from item
  where i_current_price > 50
    and i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
base_promo as (
  select p_promo_sk
  from promotion
  where p_channel_email = 'N'
    and p_channel_tv = 'N'
    and p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    and p_channel_press = 'N'
    and p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
ssr as (
  select s_store_id as store_id,
         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(sr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
         sum(ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from store_sales
  inner join base_date on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  inner join store on ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  inner join base_item on ss_item_sk = base_item.i_item_sk
  inner join base_promo on ss_promo_sk = base_promo.p_promo_sk
  left outer join store_returns on (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)
  where ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by s_store_id
),
csr as (
  select cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id,
         sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(cr_return_amount, 0)) as returns,
         sum(cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from catalog_sales
  inner join base_date on cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  inner join catalog_page on cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  inner join base_item on cs_item_sk = base_item.i_item_sk
  inner join base_promo on cs_promo_sk = base_promo.p_promo_sk
  left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk and cs_order_number = cr_order_number)
  where cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
  select web_site_id,
         sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as sales,
         sum(coalesce(wr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
         sum(ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from web_sales
  inner join base_date on ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  inner join web_site on ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  inner join base_item on ws_item_sk = base_item.i_item_sk
  inner join base_promo on ws_promo_sk = base_promo.p_promo_sk
  left outer join web_returns on (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk and ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
  where ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by web_site_id
)
select channel,
       id,
       sum(sales) as sales,
       sum(returns) as returns,
       sum(profit) as profit
from (
  select 'store channel' as channel,
         'store' || store_id as id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  from ssr
